title.en: Estimated planetary Kp is 0.33 (quiet) at 01:00 UTC on 1 October 2026.
title.zh: 2026 年 10 月 1 日 01:00 UTC，估計行星 Kp 為 0.33（平靜）。

summary.en: Latest reliable hour-start estimated Kp is 0.33 (0P) at 01:00 UTC on 1 October 2026. The 01:00 hour is complete (60 samples through 01:59; hour-start 0.33/0P, hour-end 0.67/1M). Last-180 maximum is 1.0 (first at 2026-09-30T23:59:00Z; label 1Z). Published-window maximum is 1.0 (first at 2026-09-30T23:59:00Z; label 1Z). Window start 2026-09-30T21:00:00Z (358 samples). estimated_kp remains below 5.0. The 02:00 UTC on 1 October 2026 hour is still incomplete (58 samples through 02:57).

evidence.limitations: Values are estimated Kp at 1-minute cadence and can be revised. The public feed is a rolling ~6-hour window, not a full-day archive.
evidence.method: Read the public 1-minute estimated planetary K-index JSON. Use the latest published hour-start minute of the most complete recent hour (01:00 UTC on 1 October 2026). Report last-180 and full published-window maxima.
